items: Sugar Sand Lookout is a luxurious 6 bedroom, 6.5 bathroom vacation home in a gated Santa Rosa Beach community, located directly across the street from the beach and private beach access. This stunning property sleeps 16 and features incredible Gulf views from multiple balconies and an entire third floor of open concept living, dining, and a fully stocked chef’s kitchen. Enjoy a large private pool, outdoor grill, private outdoor shower, elevator, two living rooms including a second living area with a kitchenette, two master suites with balconies, and entertainment options such as ping pong, paddle boards, basketball, board games, puzzles, and art sets. With spacious ensuite bedrooms, premium amenities, and unbeatable proximity to the beach and community pool, Sugar Sand Lookout is the ideal luxury retreat for families and groups seeking an unforgettable 30A getaway.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
